mapper.select: WITH parking_intervals AS ( SELECT d.id AS drive_id, d.car_id, d.end_position_id, d.end_date AS parking_start_date, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.car_id ORDER BY d.start_date) AS parking_end_date FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = #{carId} ) SELECT pi.drive_id, pi.car_id, start_pos.latitude, start_pos.longitude, pi.parking_start_date, pi.parking_end_date, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pi.parking_end_date - pi.parking_start_date)) AS parking_duration_seconds, start_pos.usable_battery_level AS battery_level_start, start_pos.est_battery_range_km AS range_km_start, end_pos.usable_battery_level AS battery_level_end, end_pos.est_battery_range_km AS range_km_end FROM parking_intervals pi JOIN positions start_pos ON pi.end_position_id = start_pos.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.usable_battery_level, p.est_battery_range_km FROM positions p WHERE p.date >= pi.parking_end_date AND p.car_id = pi.car_id AND p.usable_battery_level IS NOT NULL AND p.est_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.date ASC LIMIT 1 ) end_pos ON true WHERE pi.parking_end_date IS NOT NULL AND to_char(pi.parking_start_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{month} AND (pi.parking_end_date - pi.parking_start_date) > interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY pi.parking_start_date DESC;
